measurement.question: Under the proposed conditions, how likely are you to attempt a mattress purchase?

model_version: GPT-6 authored text, not an independent API run

configuration.prompt_contract: free text response to predeclared five-point question

responses.text: I would be more willing to buy if my wife and I could try a material sample, but I would still want easy returns.
responses.next_test: Offer samples while holding the return policy fixed

responses.text: I would probably not purchase right away if the return process remained uncertain, even after feeling the sample.
responses.mechanism: Tactile familiarity alone leaves reverse-logistics anxiety
responses.next_test: Keep sampling constant and test guaranteed returns

limitations: Teaching artifact, not approved through formal human review-gated record command
GPT-6 authored two variants, not independent samples of a human population
Source interview is one person; no independent validation outcomes exist
